conflict_of_interest: The Baltor components available to the treatment arm, the tasks, the evaluators and this report were all produced by the same team. Treat results as vendor-run evidence until an independent party reproduces them.
judge_evidence_note: Metrics scored by an LLM judge (even blind, order-randomised and rubric-based) are weaker evidence than deterministic tests: judges have position, length and style biases, and anonymisation cannot remove every trace of an arm.
small_n_note: With 3 trials per arm an exact two-sided permutation test cannot reach p < 0.05 (smallest possible p is 0.10); such comparisons are reported as insufficient data. Use 5 or more trials per arm.
